limits: Correct observations still enter the frozen recurrent state. Lack of additional filter benefit cannot establish total template neglect or an intrinsic FlyVis defect. Other-video donors are easier than in-scene distractors; geometry matching does not equal class/appearance matching. Gaussian labels and discriminative ridge fitting already condition the model on the observed region. Reused train26, no claim of independent generalization.
decision: Readout-only diagnostic; no efficacy claim or automatic training. Correct-template information remains in the shared recurrent state.
